name: Asterisk
source:
A man from the barely-populated Fresh Fish Island, he was raised by a pair of beautiful twins named [url=https://vndb.org/c31033]Kinou [/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c31034]Kyou[/url] . Seeking to have sex with both of the sisters by becoming a Knight, he decides to go on a journey. His primary goal, and one that the sisters encourage, is to become a great enough man to marry lots of women.

[spoiler]He is the prince of Kingdom of Arthur, and is a half-dragon. His father Tram was a human, while his mother Ruto was a dragon and a member of the Witch of the Round Table. [/spoiler]

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1061]Mangagamer[/url]]
